author: Andrew Fisher
sourceRange: 21016–21162, all114 available unique originals in the reviewed batch
implementation: Five independently matched master-plan bridge/gantry appearances; broader surroundings are retained as reference evidence, not claimed fully reconstructed.

limitations: Prior v9.20 release recorded115 working reference photographs; its deleted working inventory cannot establish a one-to-one match to these114 currently available originals.
Scene remains illustrative; no surveyed dimensions or camera geolocation are inferred.
